reviews.comment: Bao is the most boring lecturer alive. She is not an entrepreneur so she focuses solely on the entrepreneurial research she has done. The class is the most drawn out and boring class I have taken at Mays. You have to come up with a business venture with your group and follow her exact micromanager steps to get the grade you deserve.

Prof Bao is very nice and her lectures are engaging most of the time. The class is quite unique in that it heavily builds on itself throughout the course, but that does not mean it is very hard. The hardest part of this class was the midterm and final exams, but all you really need to do is just study the materials provided to you in Canvas.

reviews.comment: Super ready class. Attendance is weighted kinda heavily, so make sure you show up. Her exams were easy, and it's not hard to get an A. She is super interesting and accessible outside of class!

Class was based largely off a group project, but she was perceptive to issues with group members not pulling their own weight and adjusted grades accordingly. Tests and quizzes were common sense, and her lecturers were super engaging.
